newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian police strike blow against new drug mob.
newsitem.headline: Colombian police strike blow against new drug mob.

text.p: Colombian police struck a blow against the emerging Norte del Valle drug mob, seizing thousands of dollars worth of drug transport equipment in a series of raids on Thursday, authorities said.

Gen. Alfredo Salgado, police director of operations, said a two-cabin yacht, a tanker truck, an airplane motor and vital financial information were confiscated in the anti-drug offensive in the northwest city of Medellin and Colombia's sun-drenched Caribbean island of San Andres.

The Norte del Valle cartel, headed by Nelson Urruego, has gained prominence in its bid to fill the void in the international drug trade left by the death or arrrest of all the major capos of the notorious Medellin and Cali cartels, Salgado said.
"Nelson Urruego is one of the most important drug capos that isn't in jail," Salgado said. "He is the one we're looking for the most."
